leads.description:
PowNap helps you wake up at the right moment by tracking your recovery.

Instead of forcing you awake with a random timer, PowNap watches your heart rate and wakes you when your body feels ready.

Less grogginess.
Less guessing.
Better naps.

Power Nap

Choose:

15 min
20 min
25 min

PowNap may wake you earlier if your body recovers faster.

If not, your selected duration remains the maximum limit.

Infinity Nap

No fixed timer.

PowNap monitors your recovery and wakes you when your body appears ready.

Perfect when you want rest without watching the clock.

How it works

Start your nap.
Close your eyes.
PowNap tracks your heart rate in the background.

When your body shows signs of recovery, you're gently woken up with haptic feedback.

No loud alarms.
No countdown pressure.

Designed for calm naps

• Heart-rate based wake detection
• Gentle haptic wake-up
• Custom nap lengths
• Adjustable sensitivity
• Adjustable vibration strength
• Nap history
• Minimal distraction-free interface

Everything runs directly on your Apple Watch.

No account.
No ads.
No subscriptions.

Private by design

All processing happens locally on your device.

Your health data stays private.

Important

Apple Health access is required for heart-rate tracking.

PowNap uses a Mind & Body workout session because watchOS requires continuous heart-rate monitoring.

Activity Rings may be affected.

PowNap is not a medical device.

Compatibility

Apple Watch Series 4 or newer
(including Apple Watch SE)

Series 3 and older are not supported.

Export your Apple Health data to CSV or GPX - back it up, open it in Excel or Google Sheets, or analyze it with AI. HealthExport Remote syncs in the background and works with Claude, Codex, and any LLM  through an open-source CLI. End-to-end encrypted - we never see your data.

Key Features:
- Manual Exports: Export your health data to CSV, PDF or GPX files manually in the app while tailoring the configuration to your needs (desired data types, time period, aggregation, etc.)
- Automated Exports: Health data export can be automated using Apple Shortcuts for seamless integration into your daily routines.
- HealthExport Remote: Access your health data remotely from your computer through a secure and customizable web dashboard. Synchronization with the web app happens effortlessly without the need to open the app on your phone. Your data is end-to-end encrypted for ultimate privacy.

Your privacy is our priority - we don't collect or share your health data with anyone.

Categories of Health Data:
- Aggregation based types - Export can be aggregated by minutes, hours, days, months, or years
- Record based types - Export contains all entries from the Health app
- Workouts and Workout Routes

Activity:
- Apple Watch stand hours
- Distance cycling
- Distance downhill snow sports
- Distance swimming
- Distance walking / running
- Exercise time
- Flights Climbed
- Stand time
- Step count
- Swimming stroke count

Energy:
- Active energy burned
- Basal energy burned

Heart rate:
- Heart rate
- Resting heart rate
- Walking heart rate

Nutrition:
- Caffeine
- Calcium

- Cholesterol
- Energy consumed

- Fat total

- Iron
- Magnesium
- Potassium
- Protein

- Sugar
- Vitamin A
- Vitamin C
- Vitamin D
- Water

Wheelchair:
- Distance wheelchair
- Wheelchair push count

-----------------------------
Record based data types:
-----------------------------
Audio exposure:
- Environmental sound levels
- Headphone sound levels

Blood:
- Blood glucose
- Blood pressure (Diastolic)
- Blood pressure (Systolic)
- Insulin delivery

Body:
- 6 minute walk test
- Alcoholic beverages
- Body fat percentage
- Body mass
- Body mass index
- Body temperature
- Handwashing
- Height
- Lean body mass
- Mindfulness
- Medications

- Respiratory rate
- State of Mind
- Time in daylight
- Tooth brushing
- VO2 Max
- Waist circumference
- Walking asymmetry percentage
- Walking double support percentage
- Walking speed
- Walking steadiness
- Walking steadiness notification
- Walking step length
- Wrist temperature

Cycling:
- Cadence
- Functional threshold power
- Power
- Speed

Diving:
- Underwater depth
- Water temperature

Heart rate:
- Event: High heart rate
- Event: Irregular heart rhythm
- Event: Low heart rate
- Heart rate
- Heart rate variability (SDNN)
- Resting heart rate
- Walking heart rate

Reproductive health:
- Basal body temperature
- Cervical mucus quality
- Intermenstrual bleeding
- Menstrual flow
- Ovulation test result
- Pregnancy test
- Progesterone test
- Sexual activity

Running:
- Ground contact time
- Power
- Speed
- Stride length
- Vertical oscillation

Sleep:
- Time asleep
- Time awake
- Time core
- Time deep
- Time in bed
- Time REM

-----------------------------

HealthExport Remote lets you visualize your health data on a customizable dashboard accessible from a browser on your computer. You can also perform remote CSV exports on the website. Health data is automatically synced to the service multiple times per day in the background, so there is no need for opening the app on your phone anymore. The data is end to end encrypted between your phone and your browser. HealthExport Remote requires a subscription payment due to monthly fees associated with running the service.

leads.description:
Turn your drumming into a workout — and your Apple Watch into a timing coach.

DrumPulse listens to the motion of your snare hand, turns every strike into data, and gives you two things at once: a real fitness record and an honest report on your time. No extra gear, no mics — just your watch.

ARE YOU RUSHING OR DRAGGING?
A live groove meter swings as you play: orange when you push ahead of the beat, blue when you fall behind. At the end of each set you get an "in the pocket" score and a clear breakdown of how many hits landed early, on time, and late.

TWO WAYS TO PRACTICE
• Metronome — set a tempo and every hit is graded against a steady click, like a timing trainer.
• Free Play — no click needed. DrumPulse learns your own groove and flags when you speed up or slow down relative to yourself.

THE STORY OF YOUR SET
Averages lie — your set has an arc. DrumPulse reads the shape of the whole night:
• Set-arc trend — did you fade or hold up? "Hit strength held steady; timing tightened (±28 → ±25 ms)."
• In-song tempo drift — the per-song average hides a climb from 105 to 115. DrumPulse measures the slope inside each song: "Tempo climbed inside 13 of 21 songs — watch the push."
• Playing time — how much of the set you actually played, and your longest unbroken run.
• Dynamic range — the strength gap between your ghost notes and accents, as a ratio (5.7× soft to loud).
• Accent lag — do your hard hits land later than your soft ones? A habit mean deviation hides.

DRUMMING IS CARDIO
Every session is saved to Apple Health as a workout, with duration, heart rate, and active energy — your practice adds to your activity rings. Beyond the basics:
• Heart-rate recovery one minute after you stop — a real fitness marker.
• Time-in-zone across the whole set.
• Loudness (average and peak dB) from the watch's own hearing sensors, with a warning when a set runs loud enough, long enough, to matter.

KNOW YOUR PLAYING
• Live tempo (BPM) from the timing between your hits.
• Dynamics — every hit sorted into ghost, body, and accent relative to your own touch.
• Per-song breakdown — a long set splits into songs on the natural pauses, each with its own tempo, timing, and dynamics.
• Calibration — tap eight times and DrumPulse sets its sensitivity from your real strikes.
• Honest pauses — take a water break and the clock, calories, and grading all freeze.

ON YOUR PHONE, TOO
The DrumPulse iPhone companion pulls your sessions off the watch so you can review them on a bigger screen — trends across sets, personal bests, and the full detail of any session. Weight and intensity sync from the phone, so calories stay right.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts. No tracking. No analytics. No servers. Your motion and heart-rate data are used on your device only and never leave it; sessions sync solely between your own watch and iPhone over Apple's encrypted connection.

Built by a gigging drummer, for drummers. Strap on your watch, hit play, and find your pocket.

Note: Apple Health has no "drumming" workout type, so sessions appear as Other (branded Drumming) in the Fitness app.

leads.description:
Fituous is a calm, local-first calorie and nutrition tracker for iPhone and iPad. It brings your food diary, macros, hydration, fasting and weight into one clear view, so you can see how your day is going without juggling four apps.

START WITH A TARGET
The goal wizard asks a few questions about your body, activity and goal, then suggests a daily calorie target and a macro split. Every number stays editable. Set a target weight and date, a daily step goal and a water goal, and adjust them whenever life changes.

A DIARY THAT ADDS UP
Log breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks, then watch the calorie ring fill with each meal. Each meal gets its own color, so the ring shows how the day is built, not just a total. Your remaining calories sit alongside protein, carbs and fat. Open any day in the timeline to edit a portion, remove an entry or see what you ate.

LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
Search Open Food Facts and USDA FoodData Central, scan a barcode, or add a food of your own. Choose grams, a serving or a named portion, and Fituous scales the calories and macros for you. Build a meal from several foods and save it for next time. Mark favorites for one-tap logging, and set a repeat schedule for the days you want a saved meal offered again. Repeats are suggestions on the dashboard. Nothing is logged without you confirming it.

SAY IT, REVIEW IT
Voice logging turns one spoken phrase into proposed diary lines. Review the food, amount and meal, fix anything that was misheard, then log the whole plan at once. Speech runs on-device, and an unmatched name is never logged.

MORE THAN CALORIES
Track water with a quick-add bottle and a daily goal. Follow a fasting window with a live timer, stages and 16:8, 18:6, 20:4 or custom protocols. Record weigh-ins, set a target weight and watch the trend. Add workouts and see how movement fits alongside your calorie target. The Nutrients screen goes beyond the big three with fiber, sugar and the rest of the day's totals. Local reminders can nudge you for meals, water and weigh-ins.

SEE THE PATTERN
Progress shows calories against your target across week, month and year, plus weight trends and how consistently you have been logging. The point is not a perfect record. It is a clearer picture of what is working.

BUILT TO STAY YOURS
Fituous keeps your diary on your device. There is no account, no feed and no social layer. Export a portable backup whenever you want, and restore it when you need to. Apple Health can supply steps, workouts and weight readings; Fituous only reads from Health, it never writes back. The interface follows your system appearance, supports Dynamic Type and works on iPhone and iPad.

Fituous is for the person who wants the numbers without the noise. Log the day, see the pattern, and make the next choice a little easier.

No ads. No subscriptions. Your diary stays yours.

Get your dōTERRA® oils game on—anytime, anywhere—with the #1 app for Wellness Advocates! 
Modern Essentials® Plus delivers all you need to know for using, sharing, and succeeding with essential oils. It is the most comprehensive app for all dōTERRA® oils, blends, and products! 

Two ways to get going:

• “Basic” app—thousands of uses for dōTERRA® oils and blends for a low, one-time fee.
• “Full Access” monthly or yearly subscription—features noted below with an asterisk (*).

Here’s the in-depth information included for each dōTERRA® oil and blend:
• Primary uses
• Secondary and tertiary uses (single oils)*
• "Simple Solutions" protocols*
• Application methods
• Body systems*
• Safety data
• Detailed usage and application charts*
• Chemical constituents*
• Extraction methods
• Aromatic influences
• Blend classifications
• Blending compatibilities
• Historical uses
• Scientific and medical research references with PubMed links (some available, more coming)*

Here’s what’s in "My Usage Guide"—the working core of the app:
• Instantly search through hundreds of conditions and symptoms to find primary recommended oils, blends, supplements*, and personal care products*.
• Find secondary and tertiary recommendations of oils and blends, supplements, and personal care products.*
• Get "Simple Solutions" protocols.*
• Access recipes for personal care, health, cooking, cleaning, and home care.*

Here’s how to organize and personalize your app:*
• Mark your favorite products.
• Bookmark conditions for quick-and-easy reference.
• Track your current essential oil inventory to see which recommended oils you already have for any condition.
• Make a wish list for easy ordering.
• Write personal notes for any product or condition.

Here’s a list of current app languages:+
• Chinese  (simplified)
• Dutch
• English
• French
• German
• Italian
• Japanese
• Portuguese
• Spanish
• Russian
• More on the way!


+Each language version is based on the most recent edition of the Modern Essentials® Handbook in that language. Both “Basic” and “Full Access” apps will be updated free of charge as new editions are written and translated.


DISCLAIMER
The information contained in this app is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, prevent or otherwise reduce the effects of any disease or ailment. Consult a licensed, qualified health care provider for diagnosis, medical care, and treatment.

AromaTools®, is a true third-party company that does not profit from the sales of essential oils. It is not sponsored by, affiliated with, or endorsed by any essential oil company.   


Subscription payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the purchase price. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Setting any time after purchase. 

For additional information please see:
https://aromatools.com/pages/at-apps-privacy-policy
https://aromatools.com/pages/at-apps-terms-of-service

to 1.2.1. It's 3,977 characters, under the 4,000 limit:

Steady Tally helps you keep the small promises that add up: a morning run, eight glasses of water, ten quiet minutes, the pill you take with breakfast. One tap logs it. Every day becomes a dot. Over weeks, the dots show you what is working.

ONE TAP, THE RIGHT WAY
Each habit gets the button that fits it.
• Check-off: done or not, one tap.
• Count: tap +1 for every glass, rep or page.
• Duration: start a timer right in the list.
• Dose: tap Take and the exact time is logged.
Also track amounts with units, rate your mood or energy from 1 to 5, count the days you avoided something, or set a daily limit, like one coffee at most. A habit can follow a schedule, or have no repeat and be logged whenever it happens.

MEDICATION, ON TIME
• Set dose times, a window for each dose and gentle follow-up reminders.
• Late doses still count and are flagged, so you see the real picture.
• Log as-needed medication and see how often you take it.
• Track tablets on hand and get a refill reminder before you run out.
• See 30-day adherence and every time you took each dose.
• Export a report to share with your doctor.

APPLE WATCH
• Check off habits from your wrist with one tap.
• Turn the Digital Crown to count, and mark a dose Taken or snooze it.
• Start a timer and see each habit's last four weeks.

TAP A TAG
Put an NFC sticker where the habit happens, by the kettle or the pill box, and hold your iPhone near it to log. Add a Shortcuts automation and it logs without opening the app.

REMINDERS THAT KNOW WHEN YOU'RE DONE
• Reminders skip anything you already logged.
• Smart pace nudges only when you are behind your usual rhythm.
• Medication alerts can be Time Sensitive so a Focus does not hide them.
• Log straight from the notification: +1 glass, Taken or Snooze.

LOCK SCREEN, WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITIES
• Interactive widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Live Activities keep timers and dose windows in the Dynamic Island.
• Control Center buttons to log water or take your next dose.

SEE YOUR YEAR FILL IN
• A dot for every day, for every habit.
• Current and best streaks, goal rate and weekday patterns.
• Tap any day to fix a log or add a note.

FIND WHAT MOVES TOGETHER
• Threads show which habits rise and fall together, in plain words like "8 days in 10".
• Connections show how habits relate, for example water days and better sleep.
• Stack a new habit after one you already do, or set out to break one.
• Compare any two habits side by side.
These are patterns, not proof.

PRO INSIGHTS, BOUGHT ONCE
Optional extras, each a one-time purchase with no subscription. Everything above stays free.
• Brief and trends: your month in brief and your daily kept rate.
• Correlations: every habit against every other, the same day, the next day and by week.
• Rhythm: when you log by weekday and hour, flat and in 3D.
• Mood and notes: your ratings against the habits you kept, and the words your notes share.
Every number is worked out on your iPhone from your own logs. Sold on iPhones that support Apple Intelligence, and a purchase unlocks it on every device of your Apple Account.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO AND IPAD
• Open it up: today on the left, the habit's full story on the right.
• Half-fold it for a meditation timer, or for Rhythm in 3D above the crease.
• Closed, your habits are big tiles and every button sits in the side column.

APPLE HEALTH
Connect Apple Health and Steady Tally checks off what your iPhone and Apple Watch already know, like sleep, workouts and mindful minutes.

YOUR DATA
• No account, no ads, nothing sold. Your habits sync with iCloud.
• Import past check-offs from a CSV file, export everything, and restore it on a new iPhone.

DESIGNED FOR IOS 27 & iPhone Duo
Liquid Glass throughout, a warm paper light theme and a calm navy dark theme, or follow your iPhone.

Steady Tally is a tracker, not medical advice. Always follow your prescriber's instructions.

source.releaseNotes:
Bigger text and a tidier medication page.

• The whole app follows your system text size, up to the largest accessibility sizes. Screens scroll when they need to.
• Medication: tap the tablets on hand or a refill amount to type it on the number pad.
• Medication page: Edit opens the medication directly. History, Patterns, Refill, Archive and Delete are under More. Take shows in the medication's color.
• iPhone Duo closed: each screen's buttons sit in the side column, with a habit's Done, +1 or Start at the bottom.
• iPhone Duo open: History, Patterns, Connections and Reminders open beside the list and stay there when you close the device.
• Settings: Release notes, under Support, lists what changed in each version.

leads.description:
The Reference Guide app is the portable, user-friendly guide to Young Living®* essential oils and products. You’ll get quick information on-the-go to support better health and an essential oil lifestyle.

Now updated with all products available as of June 2026! 

With a subscription, you’ll receive more detailed information on Young Living® supplements and personal care products. Plus, with “Everyday Essentials” tips and recipes, you can confidently incorporate essential oils into all aspects of daily living.  This app combines information from the authoritative Reference Guide for Essential Oils (by Connie and Alan Higley) with convenient search, easy navigation, and personal note-taking features. Use the app anytime, anywhere to quickly find and confidently use recommended single oils and blends for hundreds of health conditions and wellness solutions.  The Reference Guide app will become your go-to source for personal essential oil use and for sharing your love of essential oils. The app features a personal guide section that details hundreds of health topics for which essential oils can be used to help support the body’s natural ability to heal itself. Additionally, key information on over 100 single oils and over 100 proprietary oil blends will help you better understand and use essential oils.  The app also provides essential oil application instructions—including detailed information about auricular internal body points, the digestive tract, the autonomic nervous system, and the olfactory system.
For over 30 years, our team has:
Reviewed thousands of research articles;
Scoured hundreds of books and lectures by essential oil experts, scientists, medical professionals, historians, and other authorities;
Gained practical experience using essential oils for ourselves and our families;
Prepared to distill all of the essential information for you in one amazing app!
(This convenient app runs on the Apple family of iPhones and iPads.)


*Abundant Health™ is a true third-party company that does not profit from the sales of essential oils and is not sponsored by, affiliated with, or endorsed by any essential oil company. We offer this material as a third-party, unbiased presentation about oils and products sold by one of the leading essential oil suppliers and producers in the world. Product names throughout this app are trademarks or registered trademarks of Young Living® Essential Oils. Abundant Health™ is not sponsored by, affiliated with, or endorsed by Young Living® Essential Oils.

DISCLAIMER

The information contained in this app is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, prevent, or otherwise reduce the effects of any disease or ailment. Consult a licensed, qualified health care provider for diagnosis, medical care, and treatment.

Price are in U.S. Dollars (USD). Pricing in other currencies and countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

Subscription payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel at any time within your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to the app. You can manage or turn off the auto-renew option in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase.

For additional information please see:
https://www.abundanthealth4u.com/privacy-policy
https://www.abundanthealth4u.com/terms

source.releaseNotes:
What’s New in Version 4.1

New Blends — Simplified by Jacob + Kait™
Six new blends added to the Simplified by Jacob + Kait collection: Amber Limeade™, Cherry Float™, Tropical Punch™ (Summer Collection), plus Warm Pumpkin Spice™, Lavender Crème™, and Fresh Linen™ (Spring Collection).

Updated Primary Uses
Common Primary Uses have been reviewed and updated across Single Oil and Blend detail pages to ensure accurate, consistent condition listings.

Improved Detail Pages
Blend, Supplement, and Personal Care detail pages have been reorganized for easier reading. Safety Data is now its own clearly labeled section, and additional details (Body Systems, Aromatic Influence, Carrier Oils, etc.) are grouped under a “More Information” dropdown to reduce clutter.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue on iOS 26 where the Simplified by Jacob + Kait collection dropdowns were unresponsive to taps.

leads.description:
Your steps and distance from Apple Health – on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch.

Small, medium and large widgets, a multi-widget with two values, and Lock Screen widgets. Every widget is set up on its own: touch and hold, then choose what it shows.

What you can do:
• Add step or distance widgets to your Home Screen (small, medium, large)
• Add a multi-widget with two values side by side or stacked
• Put widgets on your Lock Screen (circular, rectangular, inline)
• Apple Watch app with complications for your watch face (steps, distance, daily goal)
• Set daily goals for steps and distance, with progress in the widget
• Goals sync to your Apple Watch automatically
• Home screen with today's steps, goal progress and a setup guide
• Configure every widget on its own
• Choose where the value sits (top/middle/bottom, leading/center/trailing)
• Pick a text colour for Home Screen widgets from seven presets
• Hide the widget heading when you only want the number
• Preview all widgets in the app
• Step-by-step help for adding the widgets

Feels like Apple Health: bold pink numbers on a clean, adaptive background. No clutter.

Everything stays local:
• Read-only access to Apple Health
• No network requests, ever
• No analytics, no tracking
• Nothing leaves your devices – goals only go directly from iPhone to Watch

Light and dark mode. Units that match your region (km / mi). English and German. iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

leads.description:
PepCalc Pro is a precise, private calculator and tracker for reconstituted vials. Enter what is in the vial and how you mixed it, and the app works out each measurement, schedules it, records it and keeps track of what is left. Everything stays on your device: no account, no ads, no subscription.

TODAY
- See what is due and record it in one tap. The vial balance updates itself.
- The rest of your day at a glance, with undo, progress and your current streak.

ONE-STEP VIAL SETUP
- Enter the amount in the vial, the diluent and your target amount.
- See units and mL on a clear gauge, and how many measurements the vial holds.
- Save the preparation and its vial together, then schedule it in one tap.

CALCULATOR
- Exact concentration and volume, with a "Show math" view of every formula and intermediate value.
- Blend mode for vials that contain 2 to 6 components you name and enter yourself.

SCHEDULE
- A week view with each day's entries and color-coded protocols, plus a month calendar.
- Daily, weekly or custom days, several times a day, with an optional end date.
- On-device reminders. Choose whether names appear in notifications.

RECORDS
- Completed and skipped entries with exact amounts, times and notes.
- 7, 30 and 90-day trends: completion rate, streaks and a daily chart.
- Export to CSV or PDF.

INVENTORY
- Every vial's balance, run-out date and expiry, with alerts before either.
- A full history of each vial.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
- iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with two-column layouts on larger screens.
- Light and dark appearance.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Works fully offline. Your data never leaves your device.
- Optional App Lock with Face ID, Touch ID or passcode.
- Backup and restore to a file you control.
- One-time purchase. All features included.

PepCalc Pro is a calculation and record-keeping tool. It does not provide medical advice.

leads.description:
Core Atlas is a private, offline learning and practice library for adults with penises.

Learn how sexual response, erections, ejaculation, pelvic-floor coordination, pleasure, communication, and confidence fit together. Follow a self-paced 12-stage foundation or choose a guided practice for breathing, relaxation, awareness, and pelvic-floor control.

Every topic is clearly labeled as guideline-supported, clinical reference-supported, emerging or limited evidence, or traditional practice. A separate advanced track explains Mantak Chia-associated Taoist sexual cultivation with historical context, evidence limits, contraindications, and clear stop conditions. Forceful or mechanical methods are education only.

Core Atlas includes:

- A structured library of concise lessons
- Twelve guided practices and a 12-stage foundation
- Erectile-health and ejaculation-control education
- Pelvic-floor strength, coordination, and relaxation
- Consent, confidence, and partner communication
- Accessible animated diagrams and static alternatives
- Bookmarks, practice history, and goals stored only on your device
- Optional background audio for guided sessions

Core Atlas is educational and does not diagnose or treat a medical condition. It does not provide medication or supplement advice. Seek urgent care for an erection lasting 3–4 hours or longer (or a painful erection over one hour with sickle cell disease), chest symptoms, fainting, or sudden severe penile or testicular pain. Consult a qualified clinician about persistent or sudden changes, new curvature, painful ejaculation, urinary difficulty, or distress.

No account. No subscription. No advertising. No analytics. No cloud sync.
